---
title: "Reading List"
pagetitle: "Reading List"

# Items come from a single YAML file generated by _data/generate_readings.R,
# not from a folder of pages — every reading links off-site, so per-item pages
# would never be visited. The file must sit at the project root: directories
# beginning with "_" are excluded from the Quarto project and a listing cannot
# read from them.
listing:
  - id: readings
    contents: readings.yml
    type: custom
    template: ejs/reading-cards.ejs
    categories: true
    sort: "date desc"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields:
      - title
      - date
      - categories
editor: source
---

Interesting open science reading curated by our team.

Have something to add? Email us at [CSDisseminate\@gmail.com](mailto:CSDisseminate@gmail.com).
